name: Romanticism
intro: Romanticism is the name given to a shift in art and literature that was at its height from about 1780 to 1830 and was felt long after. Artists in Britain, Spain, Germany, France and the United States turned away from classical restraint and put personal feeling, the workings of the mind and the natural world at the center of their pictures.
homeDescription: How to recognize Romantic painting, from Fuseli, Blake and Goya to Friedrich, Géricault, Delacroix, Constable, Turner and the American landscape painters, in a short illustrated guide.
ldDescription: A short guide to recognizing Romantic art in Europe and the United States, 1781 to 1863, compiled from museum collection records.
